Welcome to my webpage!

I am a postdoctoral researcher at Technical University of Munich (TUM) in Germany since September 2024. I am studying in the research group "Multiscale and Stochastic Dynamics" led by Prof. Christian Kuehn.

My funding is based on Alexander von Humboldt fellowship (Sep 2024-Aug 2026).

## Research interests

- Collective dynamics
- Dynamical systems on networks
- Mathematical aspects of machine learning dynamics
- Consensus-based optimization

## Academic background

- **Humboldt Postdoctoral Research Fellow**, Department of Mathematics, Technical University of Munich  
  Sep 2024--Aug 2026. Mentor: Prof. Christian Kuehn.

- **M.S. & Ph.D. in Mathematics**, Department of Mathematical Sciences, Seoul National University  
  Sep 2020--Aug 2024. Advisor: Prof. Seung-Yeal Ha.

- **B.S. in Mathematics**, Department of Mathematics, Ewha Womans University  
  Mar 2016--Aug 2020.
